subject: inorganic
question:
无机化学·配体分类：下列配体属于哪一种 L/X 类型：chloride, bridging (μ-Cl)（μ-Cl）？
A. LX
B. X₂
C. L₂X
D. L
explanation: μ-Cl (chloride, bridging (μ-Cl)) is an LX ligand: each L gives 2 electrons and each X one, so 3 electrons in the covalent count (4 in the ionic count).
